name: LastSurvivor
description: Prize pool grows with every contribution; the 24-hour countdown resets on each press. Last contributor wins everything if the timer reaches zero.

blocks.content: Last Survivor is a countdown jackpot. Every GAS transfer buys a key, resets the timer, and crowns the sender as the heir. When the timer hits zero, the last bidder wins the entire pot.

items.value: Starts at 60 min, decays per bid

blocks.title: How to play
items: Connect your Neo N3 wallet and fund it with GAS.
Transfer GAS to the contract — the amount covers one key at the current price.
Each bid resets the timer. If you're the last bidder when it hits zero, you win the pot (minus platform fee).

blocks.content: Past rounds and their winners appear in the Live Round + Recent Winners panel on the play area above. Verify any round on NeoTube by opening the contract hash.
